name: GP Letter
description: Formal GP consultation letter with detailed clinical summary

sections.contentOverride: Include: presenting complaint and duration, relevant past medical history, current medications, social history if relevant. Exclude: detailed physical examination findings.
sections.additionalInstructionsOverride: Start the letter exactly with the following structure:Dear {{RECIPIENT_DOCTOR}}, then newline then newline, then Re: {{PATIENT_NAME}}, then newline then newline, then Thank you for the referral. Write a concise clinical history suitable for GP communication. Use professional medical language.

sections.contentOverride: Include: vital signs, physical examination findings, laboratory results with values and reference ranges, imaging findings. Exclude: subjective symptoms, patient history. Exclude: subjective symptoms, patient history.
sections.additionalInstructionsOverride: Present examination findings and test results in a structured clinical format. Only include findings that were explicitly mentioned.

sections.contentOverride: Include: primary diagnosis, differential diagnoses considered, clinical reasoning, relevant risk factors. Exclude: treatment details, medication lists.

Include: treatment initiated, medications prescribed with doses, follow-up arrangements, specific actions requested from GP, patient education provided. Exclude: examination findings, clinical reasoning.
sections.formatRuleOverride: Use numbered lists for medications and clear action items for GP
sections.additionalInstructionsOverride: Close with clear recommendations for GP follow-up. End with formal letter closing: 'Thank you for your continued care of this patient.' followed by 'Yours sincerely,' then '{{SENDER_DOCTOR}}' and '{{SENDER_TITLE}}'.
